pr_title: Fixes Div by Zero exceptions in framework models
pr_body:
#### Description
Adds missing zero checks to `EqualWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel` and `MaximumSectorExposureRiskManagementModel`. 

#### Related Issue
Closes #2211

#### Motivation and Context
Framework classes should not throw.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Manually running algorithm provided in issue #2211.

issue_context.title: Equal Weighting Portfolio Construction Div by Zero
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Framework classes should not throw.

#### Actual Behavior
Divide by zero error on some universes.

```
System.DivideByZeroException: Attempted to divide by zero.
at (wrapper managed-to-native) System.Decimal.FCallDivide(System.Decimal&,System.Decimal&)
at System.Decimal.op_Division (System.Decimal d1, System.Decimal d2) [0x00000] in <2e7c1c96edae44d496118948ca617c11>:0 
at QuantConnect.Algorithm.Framework.Portfolio.EqualWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel.CreateTargets (QuantConnect.Algorithm.Framework.QCAlgorithmFramework algorithm, QuantConnect.Algorithm.Framework.Alphas.Insight[] insights) [0x000d8] in <4c832c2253924cc19b425aa5deaa2a75>:0 
at QuantConnect.Algorithm.Framework.QCAlgorithmFramework.OnFrameworkData 
```

#### Potential Solution
Zero check and apply the solution to C# and Python.

#### Reproducing the Problem
```
class BasicTemplateFrameworkAlgorithm(QCAlgorithmFramework):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2018, 1, 5)   #Set Start Date
        self.SetEndDate(2018, 7, 5)    #Set End Date
        self.SetCash(100000)           #Set Strategy Cash
        fastPeriod = 7
        slowPeriod = 21
        count = 100
        self.UniverseSettings.Leverage = 2.0
        self.UniverseSettings.Resolution = Resolution.Daily
        self.SetUniverseSelection(EmaCrossUniverseSelectionModel(fastPeriod, slowPeriod, count))
        self.SetAlpha(ConstantAlphaModel(InsightType.Price, InsightDirection.Up, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(20), 0.025, None))
        self.SetPortfolioConstruction(EqualWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel())
        self.SetExecution(ImmediateExecutionModel())
        self.SetRiskManagement(NullRiskManagementModel())
```

#### System Information
Cloud
